I could not verify this against the source paper. Solution 3's answer, $q^{D(r-1)}$, matches the order of the wild kernel $\ker\big((A/\wp^r)^\times \to (A/\wp)^\times\big)$, which is the factor I would expect for finite-slope multiplicities in this tower. Solution 2's $q^{2D(r-1)}$ uses the wrong group, since the diagonal and unipotent parts do not both contribute independently. Solutions 1 (linear growth in $r$) and the classical-style argument behind it do not account for the characteristic-$p$ structure of the diamond action.
